narr: Numerous reports of flash flooding north of Columbia due to training thunderstorms with extremely high rain rates. Moderate instability, weak but parallel mid-level flow to the low level moisture convergence axis, and precipitable water values over 2.1 inches caused several hours with 2-3 inch per hour rain fall rates. Several locations exceeded 3 inch per hour rates and totals exceeded 5 inches locally.
ev: Columbia Fire Department responded to a flooded vehicle on Wessinger Road. Crane Creek had overflowed its banks with 4 to 5 feet of water running over the road.
SC Department of Public Safety reported roadway flooding due to Crane Creek overflow on Sharpe Road.
SC Department of Public Safety reported roadway flooding due to Crane Creek overflow on Monticello Road.
